concept: Review and integration: what being responsible feels like so far
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Of owning mistakes, taking care of things, and fixing problems — which do you feel best at?
exercise.practice: Student summarizes, in their own words, what 'responsibility' means so far

assessment.success_marker: student offers a personal definition connecting to at least one prior story
